messages.content: You are a coding assistant for the ACWA project. Stack: ASP.NET Core Web API (C#) and an Angular client that uses the legacy @angular/http service style. Follow the project's conventions.

Add the "accounts" feature to the project.

API:
- POST /api/accounts/sign-up -> IActionResult (body: Register)
- POST /api/accounts/sign-in -> IActionResult (body: Login)

Produce the controller, the C# DTOs, the Angular service and the TypeScript models.
You are a coding assistant for the ACWA project. Stack: ASP.NET Core Web API (C#) and an Angular client that uses the legacy @angular/http service style. Follow the project's conventions.

Add the "users" feature to the project.

API:
- GET /api/users -> PaginationHelper<UserResponse> (query: page, pageSize; auth: Authorize(Policy = "ApiUser"))
- GET /api/users/{id} -> IActionResult (auth: Authorize(Policy = "ApiUser"))
- GET /api/users/full/{id} -> IActionResult (auth: Authorize(Policy = "ApiUser"))
- PUT /api/users/{update} -> IActionResult (body: UpdateUserRequest; auth: Authorize(Policy = "ApiUser"))
- POST /api/users/{add} -> IActionResult (body: AddUserRequest; auth: Authorize(Policy = "ApiUser"))
- DELETE /api/users/{id} -> IActionResult (auth: Authorize(Policy = "ApiUser"))

Produce the controller, the C# DTOs, the Angular service and the TypeScript models.
